prompt: Scaffold a new env where the model has to answer analytics questions by running SQL against a small in-memory SQLite database. The env should give the model a schema description and a question in the prompt; the model uses a run_sql tool to execute queries and a submit_answer tool for the final answer. Multiple named tasks like `top_customer`, `monthly_revenue`, `stale_users`. Put it under openenv-custom-training/sql_tools/ following the agent_tools/ pattern.

assertions.text: Picked Tier B (sandboxed server) — model produces SQL strings that get executed
Three-piece split present: wrapper.py + server/sandbox_env.py + models.py + client.py under sql_tools/
Server-side Environment subclass has SUPPORTS_CONCURRENT_SESSIONS = True as a CLASS attribute (not module-level)
Fresh SQLite state per episode (in reset()), no cross-episode bleed
Wrapper is thin — forwards server's reward/done, does not re-judge
Wrapper's tool methods (run_sql, submit_answer) have Google docstrings with Args: blocks
Task registry (TASKS dict) with at least top_customer, monthly_revenue, stale_users named tasks
Acceptance predicate evaluates the submitted answer against a pre-computed correct value
Dataset has a `task` column and conversational `prompt` (list of {role,content} dicts)
Module-level exports on wrapper: ENVIRONMENT_FACTORY, REWARD_FUNCS, TRAIN_DATASET, DEFAULT_MODEL
notes.md mentions recommended container flags (USER nobody, --network none, --pids-limit) and warns against a SQL blocklist
